name: Decision Support
description: Lay out options, criteria, and risks without inventing a sure answer.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read a project file that the question depends on.
Search for sources that can answer the question.
Read a specific page that a search result named.
Read a long document section instead of a lone snippet.

validation.rule: Options are compared on stated criteria. Risks stay visible, and no option is marked certain without evidence.
